look: Ruin Gargoyle, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Ruin Gargoyles family: classic stone gargoyle with bat wings, crouched and ready to pounce. Family anatomy: stone gargoyles and imps with bat wings, horns and pebbled stone skin. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are slate-grey grit crystal. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, clear stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
